data.one_liner: Smoothly animate between any two BoxDecoration including colors, gradients, and images.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SmoothAnimatedContainer and SmoothDecorationTween to transition between complex BoxDecoration instances. It handles transitions between colors and gradients, different gradient types, and images where default Flutter widgets fall short.
use_when: You need to animate between a color background and a gradient background
You need to animate background images smoothly in a container
You want a drop-in alternative to AnimatedContainer for complex decorations
avoid_when: You need to animate container shapes (like morphing shapes)
You are using a version of Flutter older than 3.27
strengths: Supports transitions between colors, different gradient types, and images
Works out of the box with Material, Cupertino, or headless apps using only widgets
Fixes various animation jump and interruption bugs present in default implementations
weaknesses: Does not implement the animation of container shapes

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: For general-purpose animation effects and declarative chains across multiple widget properties.

data.minimal_example:
SmoothAnimatedContainer(
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  width: 200,
  height: 200,
  decoration: toggled ? decoration1 : decoration2,
)
